C13HPT for JBRS
==============

This is an independent, lightweight JBRS shader pack inspired by the
performance-oriented look suggested by the supplied Chocapic13 HighPerformance
Toaster archive. It is adapted to JBRS's renderer and is not an OptiFine pack.
No shader source from that archive is included here.

The pack includes separate GLSL 1.20 shaders for desktop OpenGL 2.1 and GLSL
ES 1.00 shaders for GLES2. It adds daylight and night color grading, a warm
twilight transition, distance fog, and preserves JBRS's built-in shadow pass.
The detail setting controls the strength of the additional color treatment.

Select C13HPT under Settings > Graphics > Shader pack. The game falls back to
its built-in renderer if either shader fails to compile.
